full_judgment: 2. The petitioner, claiming to be a tenant holding land contiguous to the land sold in auction on 3-3-56 at a certificate sale, prayed for pre-emption under section 96(1) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. The subject-matter of the pre-emption relates to the land recorded in R.S. Khatian 797 of Mouza Shahajira within police station Gournadi.
